avoid_areas: Philosophy of mind (introspection and artificial systems) (Can the self-reports of a system trained on human self-reports ever be evidence about that system's own internal states, or are they screened off by the training explanation?)

Philosophy of science (confirmation theory and predictivism) (When a hypothesis is chosen by searching a very large space of candidates for fit to the data, does that fit confirm it less than the same fit would confirm a hypothesis proposed in advance? If so, can the 'prediction vs. accommodation' debate be settled by accounting precisely for the search process rather than for timing?)
